title: The artifact architecture of Golmet
html:
English | Português (Brasil)

The artifact architecture of Golmet

The whole structure of Golmet — the directories, the formats, the validations — exists to sustain a chain of documents where each one is born from another and feeds the next ones. This page tells that chain as a story (the same journey as the tutorials, seen from above) and closes with the complete reference table.

The story: the seed and the descent

The charter is the seed. The PROJECT_CHARTER.md declares what the product is — and where its code comes from (the Repos table of §1). Everything in the MeuApp workspace descends from the charter: it is the first document, and that is why golmet validate complains when it is missing or unreadable — no seed, no tree.

REQUIREMENTS inherits and expands. The product's business rules (the ## RN-NNN sections) are a refinement of the charter: the charter says "it's a scheduling product", the RNs say "booking with slot confirmation, 15-minute window". Confirmed RNs are the only foundation of implementation — a Feature can only be born anchored to an RN (anchor: RN-001); anchoring to a PEND is a blocking error (H1). It is the rule that keeps the team from implementing what nobody confirmed.

Specs derive from the RNs. Each RN with implementation ahead earns the folder analysis/RN-NNN — title/ with the functional and technical analysis — the HOW. The spec is written from the rule (never the other way around): when a spec diverges from its RN, either the spec is stale (and must declare by which CR), or there was a derivation mistake. That is why the FORMAT has section §7.7: the specs/DATA_MODEL.md aggregate grows with maturity, and the break by micro-context exists so whoever implements one RN doesn't have to load the whole bank.

The delivery delivers. The Feature in delivery/<group>/RN-NNN — title — Feature.md is the moving part: tasks with state and owner, execution coordinated by the dev skills. The feature moving is what raises the RN to active — with evidence ([path:line @hash]), the file+line+commit bond with the code.

The evidence is the seal. And here is Golmet's difference from any traditional doc: RN-001 doesn't say "was implemented" — it points at the code, and golmet validate confirms the pointing is real (the file exists, the line exists, the hash is the HEAD — H7, S2). Documentation the machine verifies is the only kind the team keeps trusting.

The index is the memory of states. The golmet.index.json keeps every entity's state at the last good validation. When a confirmed rule changes, the path is the CR (CHANGE_REQUESTS.md records the change, the RN updates, the spec drops to stale with the reason); when a technical decision is made, it becomes an ADR in DECISIONS.md — immutable, because the history of "why" is what the team will re-read.

And what closes the knowledge circle: the TRACEABILITY (in quality/) maps RN → generated documents; the knowledge pack (patterns, domains, rules) inherits what the project revealed — the chain doesn't end at the delivery, it ends by becoming an organizational asset.

The reference table

Document Where it lives Feeds Is fed by Produced by (gm-*)
PROJECT_CHARTER.md workspace root REQUIREMENTS, specs, everything the founding conversation gm-charter
REQUIREMENTS.md (RNs + PENDs) root specs, delivery (the anchors) charter + elicitation with the owner gm-req (via gm-clarify)
CHANGE_REQUESTS.md (CRs) root RNs (the update), specs (the staleness) post-confirmation changes gm-req (gm-change-request)
DECISIONS.md (ADRs) root the technical decisions of specs the architecture discussion gm-decision-log
analysis/RN-NNN/ (functional + technical) analysis/ the Feature and the tasks the RNs gm-taskspec
specs/DATA_MODEL.md etc. specs/ implementation, db drift the RNs gm-datamodel, gm-apicontracts, gm-arch, gm-uispec, gm-criteria
delivery/RN-NNN — Feature.md delivery/ the code (the tasks) the technical analysis gm-taskspec
golmet.index.json root the validate comparisons the prose (the kit writes) the kit (golmet validate/index)
quality/TRACEABILITY.md quality/ the coverage audit everything gm-traceability
knowledge pack (rules/, accumulation/, domains/) the org's pack the next projects retrospectives and decisions gm-rule-keeper, gm-pattern-extractor, gm-domain-research

The rules that sustain the chain

The chain is only worth it if it's verified. The FORMAT v1 defines the checks that keep it from rotting: H1 (PEND never anchors a Feature), H3 (a ready Feature requires an active RN), H4 (an active RN requires evidence), H7 (the evidence resolves in the code), H10 (cross-references resolve), H8 (the state in the index is the history — an accepted ADR doesn't change). The soft (S1–S5) and the lint (L1–L10) watch the rest — the full discipline in FORMAT §9.
